rationale.claim: Complete finite computable criterion for a SPECIFIED onto block self-map of a nonempty two-sided irreducible sofic shift to extend into that shift from a containing SFT. Equivalent LT-separation/canonical approximation test with N=max(2,ell,4(|M|+1)); all completions, radii and containing alphabets are covered.
rationale.identity: Matches original4600024/AMR-045-0024/Boyle16.3 mixing-sofic specified-map question, strengthened to irreducibility. The published PRZ2014 Theorem4.2 separator bound is an explicit imported ingredient; Dykstra, Barth–Dykstra and Ballier are credited.
rationale.limits: Not existence over all maps, CA stability, unrestricted reducible-sofic classification, a new general separation theorem, practical-complexity improvement or an implemented arbitrary-input solver. Priority, version and body-access limits are explicit. The48 candidate blobs match both old scientific and current integration heads.
